data.name: Cli.Help
data.value:
UseControl: restrictions for standard Windows accounts. Run as administrator. uc status state of the service, of every restricted account and its games uc apply apply the configuration now (and turn restrictions back on) uc suspend [--yes] remove all restrictions until "uc apply" uc preview every rule that would be written, and why uc audit security check of this PC uc users list | add [--profile

] | move | remove uc profile list | add [--from ] | rename | remove uc games [status] who may play now and how much was played today uc games schedule [list] | add - [--limit ] | remove games run only in these hours; days: mon-fri, sat,sun, weekdays, weekend, all uc games lock [--user ] block games until the end of the day uc games unlock [--user ] take that back: the schedule applies again uc games close on|off close games when games time is over uc games find [--add] look for game folders that are not blocked yet uc block folder [--category games|vpn|tools|other] uc block name [--category ...] uc block file [--category ...] by fingerprint: renaming does not help uc unblock folder | name | file uc allow folder a program folder that runs inside a blocked place uc allow remove uc access deny|allow [--rights read,write,execute,delete|full] [--users a,b] uc access remove uc ext allow|remove chrome|edge|firefox uc policy set chrome|edge|firefox uc policy remove chrome|edge|firefox uc config export | import uc install [--from ] install or update (run from the folder with the published programs) uc uninstall [--keep-restrictions] [--purge] [--yes] uc update [check] | install look for a new version / install it uc update daily on|off | auto on|off check every day / install by itself uc ping | help Commands that change a profile (games, block, unblock, allow, ext, policy) take --profile when there is more than one profile. Options: --json (status, preview, audit, games find), --lang en|uk|de|pl|de|pl|de|pl

data.name: Ui.Accounts.Help
data.value:
Restrictions apply only to restricted accounts. Administrators are not listed and are never restricted. An account appears here after its first sign-in.
A profile is a set of rules: apps and games, Windows restrictions, browsers. Each account can have its own profile, or several accounts can share one.

data.name: Ui.Games.Help
data.value: Games are the entries set to “Game” in the list below. They run only during the schedule and within the daily limit. Five minutes before the end, a warning appears on the account's screen. Online games blocked by a DNS filter are not affected.

data.name: Ui.Access.Help
data.value:
UseControl keeps track of every permission it adds and removes exactly those; other permissions are never touched. Windows folders, drive roots, Program Files and the Users folder cannot be used.
To stop programs from starting in a folder, use Apps and games.

data.value:
Each entry is a program, a program name or a folder. “Game” entries run only during game time; “Always blocked” entries never run.
A program is recognised by its content, so renaming, moving or copying it does not help, and its name blocks newer versions too. A folder covers every program inside it.
